title: RBI Advances the Cut-Off for FCNR(B)/NRE Deposits Excluded From Priority Sector ANBC
case_name: Reserve Bank of India (Priority Sector Lending - Targets and Classification) Third Amendment Directions, 2026
card_summary: RBI amended its Priority Sector Lending Directions to move the cut-off for excluding advances funded by fresh FCNR(B) and NRE term deposits from Adjusted Net Bank Credit, from 30 September 2026 to 31 August 2026. The exclusion applies only to qualifying deposits mobilised within the revised window, and the amount excluded cannot exceed the deposits eligible for the matching CRR/SLR exemption.
card_tip: Banks computing priority sector achievement for the current half year should re-check which FCNR(B)/NRE funded advances still qualify for ANBC exclusion under the earlier 30 September cut-off, since it no longer applies.
verification_notes: Circular number (RBI/2026-27/256), FIDD reference, the 11 September 2026 date, the shift of the cut-off date from 30 September 2026 to 31 August 2026, and the CRR/SLR exemption cap are corroborated across the RBI circular index listing, TaxGuru and Taxmann. This follows an earlier Second Amendment of 7 August 2026 that had set the original 30 September date.
